rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: 不動産部門の宅地販売の12%がレナー向け
relations.text_en: Lennar Homes took 12% of its real estate segment land sales

source.label: Valhi 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: DR Horton - 34%, Richmond American Homes - 12% and Lennar Homes - 12%

relations.text: 開発区画の宅地をレナーに売却する契約
relations.text_en: Contract to sell developed lots to Lennar Colorado

source.label: Pure Cycle 10-K(2025年8月期)
source.quote: Contract for Purchase and Sale of Real Estate, dated February 19, 2021, by and between PCY Holdings, LLC and Lennar Colorado, LLC

companies.name: ミルローズ・プロパティーズ

relations.text: レナーが宅地の購入オプションを行使して事業が成り立つ
relations.text_en: Depends on Lennar regularly exercising its homesite purchase options

source.label: Millrose Properties 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: expectations that Lennar will fully perform on all its obligations pursuant to the Lennar Agreements (and that there will be regular and timely exercises of its Purchase Options)

relations.text: レナーが約40%を持つ筆頭株主
relations.text_en: Lennar owns about 40% and is its largest equity owner

source.label: Five Point 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Lennar is our largest equity owner and will be engaging in transactions with us and may compete with us.

companies.name: ラウシュ・コールマン・ホームズ

relations.text: 2025年2月に買収(土地はミルローズが取得)
relations.text_en: Acquired in February 2025 (Millrose took the land assets)

source.label: Lennar 10-K(2025年11月期)
source.quote: We acquired Rausch's homebuilding operations while Millrose acquired Rausch's land assets and we have options on the land.

relations.text: 賃貸住宅事業クアテラをTPGに売却

source.label: Lennar 10-K(2025年11月期)
source.quote: The sale of Quarterra to TPG did not have a material impact on our consolidated financial statements.

relations.text: 関連当事者のレナーに同意料800万ドルを支払い
relations.text_en: Paid related party Lennar $8 million for its consent to a sale

source.label: Hippo 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: the Company (i) paid Lennar $ 8 million in consideration for Lennar's required consent to the Westwood Sale

companies.name: ボールドウィン・インシュアランス

relations.text: レナーと保険代理店の合弁(レナー80%)
relations.text_en: Joint venture insurance agency with Lennar (Lennar holds 80%)

source.label: Baldwin Insurance Group 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: a joint venture formed between Hippo and Lennar Title Group, LLC ("Lennar"), which holds 100 % of the Class B membership interest (representing an 80% total interest).

companies.name: ランドシー・ホームズ

relations.text: 直接競合する全国大手にレナーを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Lennar among major national builders it competes with directly

source.label: Landsea Homes 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: we compete directly with major national builders such as KB Home, Lennar Corporation, Tri Pointe Homes, Inc., PulteGroup, Inc., and D.R.
